title: Split three more linux_configuration scripts and harden the split verifier
objective: Bring transcribe.sh (473), setup_activitywatch.sh (457) and setup_wireguard_ssh.sh (464) under the 250-line cap, and make the verifier catch a split that lands inside a heredoc.
acceptance_criteria: All three entry scripts and all nine new libs are at most 250 lines.
The pre-commit shellcheck hook passes on every touched file, with no new suppression and no disable directive.

meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh parses every lib with bash -n BEFORE linting the entry script, and reports the lib by name when it fails. A heredoc cut otherwise surfaces as a confusing SC1094 on the caller.
That new check is proven in both directions: it fails on a deliberately unterminated heredoc and passes once restored.
No script is executed. These install CUDA runtimes, start services and rewrite sshd and nftables config.
enforce_vbox_hosts.sh is fully restored, leaving no partial split and no orphan lib directory.
out_of_scope: Executing any install or firewall step.
enforce_vbox_hosts.sh, whose seam fell inside a heredoc.
Changing what any script does when run, beyond the cd guard.
verifier: meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh per script, plus a deliberate heredoc-corruption test of the verifier itself, plus pre-commit run --files and check_file_length.sh.
